rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотрите! Он опять повторяет за мной!
rows.text: Look! He's copying me again!
rows.heard: Look, he's copying me again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я машу — и он машет! Эй, хватит копировать!
rows.text: I wave, and he waves! Hey, stop copying!
rows.heard: I wave and he waves. Hey, stop copying!

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And he jumps with me!
rows.heard: And he jumps with me.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Ron, that's your reflection.
rows.heard: Ron, that's your reflection.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Такая же кепка. Такой же нос. Даже выражение мордочки моё!
rows.text: Same cap. Same nose. Even the same face!
rows.heard: Same cap, same nose, even the same face.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Yesterday you knew it was you.
rows.heard: Yesterday you knew it was you.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Узнал. Но почему оно всё за мной повторяет?
rows.text: I did. But why does it copy everything I do?
rows.heard: I did, but why does it copy everything I do?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Зеркало отражает свет. Свет от тебя попадает в зеркало, а от него — в твои глаза.
rows.text: A mirror bounces light. Light goes from you to the mirror, and then into your eyes.
rows.heard: A mirror bounces light. Light goes from you to the mirror, and then into your eyes.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Is that why we see ourselves?
rows.heard: Is that why we see ourselves?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Yes. There's no other puppy inside.
rows.heard: Yes, there's no other puppy inside.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Жаль. Я уже хотел попросить его убрать игрушки.
rows.text: Too bad. I wanted him to tidy up my toys.
rows.heard: Too bad, I wanted him to tidy up my toys.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: So you'll have to do it yourself?
rows.heard: So you'll have to do it yourself.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Or call my real friends!
rows.heard: or call my real friends.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А с друзьями можно поиграть в живое зеркало.
rows.text: And with friends, we can play Living Mirror.
rows.heard: And with friends, we can play Living Mirror.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: I want to try!
rows.heard: I want to try.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я показываю движение. Пик смотрит и повторяет.
rows.text: I show a move. Pik watches and copies it.
rows.heard: I show a move, pick watches and copies it.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Then we switch.
rows.heard: Then we switch.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It worked!
rows.heard: It worked.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Now you lead.
rows.heard: Now you eat.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Yay! I can be a mirror!
rows.heard: Yay, I can be a mirror!

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А настоящее зеркало может придумать своё движение?
rows.text: Can a real mirror make up its own move?
rows.heard: Can a real mirror make up its own move?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Нет. Отражение повторяет тебя. А друг сам решает, что делать.
rows.text: No. A reflection copies you. But a friend decides what to do.
rows.heard: No, a reflection copies you, but a friend decides what to do.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Поэтому мы и можем меняться ролями.
rows.text: That's why we can take turns.
rows.heard: That's why we can take turns.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Can I try now?
rows.heard: Can I try now?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Sure. Watch me.
rows.heard: Sure, watch me.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Filya copied every move!
rows.heard: Fill your carpet every move.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: This is fun!
rows.heard: This is fun.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А теперь сыграем иначе. Сначала посмотри, потом повтори по памяти.
rows.text: Now let's play another way. First watch, then copy from memory.
rows.heard: Now let's play another way. First watch, then copy from memory.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Let's start with two moves.
rows.heard: Let's start with two moves.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я покажу их целиком. Ты дождись, когда я закончу.
rows.text: I'll show both moves. Wait until I'm done.
rows.heard: I'll show both moves, wait until I'm done.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Oops. I started with the bow.
rows.heard: Oops, I started with the bow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Движения ты запомнил. Только поменял их местами.
rows.text: You remembered the moves. You just mixed up the order.
rows.heard: You remembered the moves, you just mixed up the order.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: When I was watching, it was easy.
rows.heard: When I was watching, it was easy.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: But from memory, it's harder.
rows.heard: But from memory, it's harder.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Let's make up a short hint.
rows.heard: Let's make up a short hint.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: First hello, then bow!
rows.heard: First hello, then bow.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Let's show it slowly.
rows.heard: Let's show it slowly.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Hello.
rows.heard: Hello?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Bow.
rows.heard: Bell

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: First hello, then bow.
rows.heard: First to low, then bow.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It worked!
rows.heard: It worked.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: The words helped me remember the order.
rows.heard: The words helped me remember the order.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Now we're very polite mirrors!
rows.heard: Now we're very polite mirrors.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: И умеем здороваться до прощального поклона.
rows.text: And we say hello before the goodbye bow.
rows.heard: And we say hello before the goodbye bow.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: На площадке друзья добавили к игре новое движение.
rows.text: At the playground, the friends added a new move to the game.
rows.heard: At the playground, the friends added a new move to the game.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: After the bow, we clap.
rows.heard: After the bow we clap.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: So now I have to remember three?
rows.heard: So now I have to remember three.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Первые два ты уже знаешь. Добавим к ним одно.
rows.text: You already know the first two. We'll just add one.
rows.heard: You already know the first two. We'll just add one.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Hello, bow, clap.
rows.heard: Hello Bo Clap!

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Ты повторил все три по порядку!
rows.text: You did all three in order!
rows.heard: You did all three in order.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: And nobody gave me hints!
rows.heard: And nobody gave me hints.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Do you want to show us now?
rows.heard: Do you want to show us now?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я? А если вы не поймёте?
rows.text: Me? What if you don't get it?
rows.heard: Me, what if you don't get it?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: You'll explain. We're learning too.
rows.heard: You'll explain, we're learning too.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Тогда новая задача. Проверяем порядок: привет, поклон, хлопок.
rows.text: Then here's a new task. Let's check the order: hello, bow, clap.
rows.heard: Then here's a new task. Let's check the order. Hello, bow, clap.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And who will show it?
rows.heard: and who will show it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Me! And I'll mix something up on purpose.
rows.heard: Me, and I'll mix something up on purpose.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Мы сначала досмотрим, а потом назовём замену.
rows.text: We'll watch to the end first, then say what changed.
rows.heard: We'll watch to the end first, then say what changed.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Which move did Ron change?
rows.heard: Which move did Ron change?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: He squatted instead of bowing.
rows.heard: He squatted instead of bowing.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: But he kept the hello and the clap.
rows.heard: but he kept the hello and the clap.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I was checking the view from down there!
rows.heard: I was checking the view from down there.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Видно. Но в нашем порядке нужен поклон.
rows.text: Yes, you can see. But our order has a bow.
rows.heard: Yes, you can see, but our order has a bow.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Now it's all in order.
rows.heard: Now it's all in order.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: I led the game myself!
rows.heard: I led the game myself.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я сам запутал. И сам исправил!
rows.text: And I mixed it up myself. And fixed it myself!
rows.heard: and I mixed it up myself and fixed it myself.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А теперь снова живое зеркало. Повторяйте каждое движение сразу за мной!
rows.text: And now, Living Mirror again. Copy every move right after me!
rows.heard: And now, living mirror again. Copy every move right after me.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Everyone ready?
rows.heard: Everyone ready?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Yes!
rows.heard: Yes.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Yes!
rows.heard: Yes.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: A whole team of jumping mirrors!
rows.heard: A whole team of jumping mirrors.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: And everyone's watching me!
rows.heard: and everyone's watching me.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ты показывал понятно. Нам было легко повторять.
rows.text: You showed it clearly. It was easy to copy.
rows.heard: you showed it clearly, it was easy to copy.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Теперь у нас есть ещё один ведущий.
rows.text: Now we have one more leader.
rows.heard: Now we have one more leader.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я хочу показать самое сонное движение.
rows.text: And I want to show the sleepiest move.
rows.heard: And I want to show the sleepiest move.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: I think it's time to end this game.
rows.heard: I think it's time to end this game.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Careful. The next move is sleeping!
rows.heard: Careful, the next move is sleeping.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Смотрите, дуб! А здесь лежит жёлудь.
rows.text: Look, an oak tree! And here's an acorn.
rows.heard: Look an oak tree, and here's an acorn.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: So tiny.
rows.heard: So tiny.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And it has its own little hat!
rows.heard: and it has its own little hat.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Как из него может вырасти огромный дуб?
rows.text: How can a huge oak grow from it?
rows.heard: How can a huge oak grow from it?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Nice mystery.
rows.heard: Nice mystery.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Завтра узнаем, что нужно растению для роста.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll learn what a plant needs to grow.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll learn what a plant needs to grow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Just don't plant it at home.
rows.heard: Just don't plan it at home.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Why?
rows.heard: Why?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The sofa might have to move out!
rows.heard: The sofa may have to move out.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
